title: Release 1.0: the presentation skill is in design, and the new words are in review

blocks.title: Where the work is
blocks.key: Key: each box has its level and its state word. Double box: you are here.

items: **Release 1.0**: the version you ship next. Milestones 1 to 4 are done.
**New words, part 1**: renames program to milestone in the code, the README and the docs. Its four checks run now.
**Milestone 5, Sage feel**: how sage talks to you and works on each kind of task, as skills and playbooks. You approved its plan of 8 tasks.
**Presentation skill**: the pilot of milestone 5: how every message reaches you. It is in its design step: one example page for each kind of message. Its build waits for part 1.
**The playbooks**: how sage works on each kind of task: design, architecture, study, debugging, feature, refactor, milestone. They start after the pilot merges.
**New words, parts 2 and 3**: the release level, then the six state words on the board. Each waits for the part before it.
**Research for the skill**: proven text formats (done), picture formats (in its evidence review), one way to show visuals (in a repair round).
You approved the design for the new words and its three pull requests (18:43).
Part 1 was built (19:55). Its code review, security review, UX review and QA run now.
The text formats research ended. The other two studies are in their reviews.

blocks.label: If this happens
blocks.text: if a review of part 1 finds a high finding, I start a repair round and do not ask you.

blocks.label: What I need from you
blocks.text: nothing now. Next: look at the example pages and tell me what to change.
